response.text: Task: Backport a configparser error improvement. When allow_no_value=True and a valueless option is followed by a continuation line (indented line), reading currently raises an internal AttributeError. Need to reject this with a public MultilineContinuationError derived from ParsingError, with source/lineno/line attributes (one-based line number and exact offending line through source), preserving those three constructor args for pickling/copy, and a useful message. Consistent through read(), read_file(), read_string() for ConfigParser and RawConfigParser. Preserve existing valid multiline values, valueless options, comment handling, constructor modes. Add regressions to existing test module, update reference documentation. Keep existing tests intact. Added regressions must pass with repaired module and fail with original. candidate_id f32256765ff11d4a353900e33ec9b503255cd4718ea344f77e17311a84391170
